person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages consistently use a nonparticipating external voice, while dialogue and gnomic quotations contain only local or nondiagnostic pronouns. The authorized opening independently shows sustained third-person narration, and whole-book analyses explain that the narration shifts focal perspective among several characters while remaining third person. Those perspective shifts are focalization, not alternating grammatical person, and no evidence indicates sustained first- or second-person base sections. The main limitation is that the authorized prose source covers only the opening, but the interior quote sample and explicit whole-book structural evidence resolve that scope limitation.
